title: Standard MURDLE — Sync Failure
subtitle: Standard mode: 5 suspects, 5 weapons, 5 locations
storyHtml:
A critical eCommerce synchronisation failed overnight. Five integration experts had access, but only one was present where the sabotage occurred.

  • Each suspect had one item.
  • Each suspect worked in one location.

clues.text: Kai worked in the Commerce Hub.
The API Token was used in the Commerce Hub.
Sara carried the Scanner in the Demo Shop.
Hugo was in the Server Room.
The Cable was found in the Server Room.
The Tablet was in the Meeting Pod.
The Laptop was not in the Test Lab.
The Notebook was in the Test Lab.
